define.markdownDescription: Actual name of the define as it's used in `-D` on the CLI and in Haxe code.

doc.markdownDescription: Documentation for the define that is shown in `--help-defines`.

platforms.markdownDescription: Platforms on which this define has an effect.

devcomment.markdownDescription: Internal comment that is not exposed.

reserved.markdownDescription: Reserved defines may not be defined from the command line.

deprecated.markdownDescription: Reason for the define to be deprecated.

default.markdownDescription: Default value if not explicitly set.

deprecatedDefine.markdownDescription: Replace and deprecate the given definition name, which can still be used in -D.
